fees.notes: International fee not published: Saito University College does not publish tuition fees online. The official application form states fees are shown in the programme intake price list (not available online) and are subject to annual revision. Checked the programme page (https://saito.edu.my/diploma-in-business-management/), the admissions page (https://saito.edu.my/admissions/) and the application form (https://saito.edu.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/saito-uc-application-form-1_Compressed.pdf) (accessed 2026-09-18).
